designationHistory.indexText: Fisherman Island National Wildlife Refuge, at the mouth of Chesapeake Bay, was established in 1969 on an island the Navy had used; full ownership passed from the Navy to the Fish and Wildlife Service in 1973.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Eastern Shore of Virginia and Fisherman Island NWRs Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2004 (ServCat 1416)
